tinker.name: WebSocket
tinker.description: WebSocket client for connecting, sending messages, and inspecting traffic

zh-CN.name: WebSocket
zh-CN.description: WebSocket 调试工具，支持连接、发送消息和查看通信内容

connect.description: Connect to a WebSocket server (ws:// or wss://). Waits until the connection is open or fails. Selects the new connection. Call get afterward to inspect messages, or send to transmit data.

timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for the connection to open. Defaults to 10000.

list.description: List all WebSocket connections with id, url, status, error, and message count. Does not include message bodies — use get for that.

get.description: Get a connection's status and recent messages. Defaults to the selected connection. Use after connect or send to inspect traffic.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list/connect. Defaults to the selected connection.

limit.description: Max number of recent messages to return. Defaults to 50.

filter.description: Filter messages by direction. Defaults to all (includes system events).

send.description: Send a text message on an open WebSocket connection. Call connect first. Updates the plugin UI and returns recent messages.

connection_id.description: Connection id. Defaults to the selected connection.

disconnect.description: Close a WebSocket connection and wait until it settles. Defaults to the selected connection.

connection_id.description: Connection id. Defaults to the selected connection.

clear_messages.description: Clear the message history for a connection. Defaults to the selected connection.

connection_id.description: Connection id. Defaults to the selected connection.
